title: Ordinary World
title_zh: 平凡的世界
summary_en: A realist novel reflecting the lives, struggles, and dreams of ordinary people in China's reform era.
summary_zh: 一部现实主义作品，描写改革年代普通人的生活、奋斗与理想。
best_quote_en: Even in the most ordinary life, there is a shining strength.
best_quote_zh: 即使是平凡的生活，也有闪光的力量。

title: Awakening of Cognition
title_zh: 认知觉醒
summary_en: A book on how to improve cognition, optimize habits, and achieve personal growth.
summary_zh: 一本探讨如何提升认知、优化习惯，实现自我成长的作品。
best_quote_en: Cognition determines destiny; the higher your perspective, the farther you can go.
best_quote_zh: 认知决定命运，站得越高，看得越远。

title: The Little Prince
title_zh: 小王子
source: 安托万·德·圣-埃克苏佩里
summary_en: A poetic fable about a young prince exploring the universe and discovering love, loneliness, and meaning.
summary_zh: 一部诗意的寓言，讲述小王子探索宇宙，发现爱、孤独与意义的故事。
best_quote_en: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
best_quote_zh: 真正重要的东西，用眼睛是看不见的。

title: Destiny
title_zh: 命运
summary_en: A novel that weaves family stories and fate, reflecting the struggles of ordinary people.
summary_zh: 一部交织家庭故事与命运的小说，展现普通人的挣扎与生命张力。
best_quote_en: Fate is like the tide, sometimes pushing us forward, sometimes pulling us back.
best_quote_zh: 命运如潮，有时推着我们前进，有时把我们拉回。

title: One Sentence Worth Ten Thousand
title_zh: 一句顶一万句
summary_en: A novel about the difficulty of communication and the loneliness of individuals in modern society.
summary_zh: 一部描写沟通困境与现代人孤独的小说。
best_quote_en: People talk endlessly, but only one sentence truly hits the heart.
best_quote_zh: 人们说了一万句废话，可能只有一句说到心里。

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
title_zh: 百年孤独
source: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯
summary_en: A masterpiece of magical realism, narrating the rise and fall of the Buendía family over a century.
summary_zh: 魔幻现实主义经典，讲述布恩迪亚家族百年的兴衰史。
best_quote_en: Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice.
best_quote_zh: 多年以后，奥雷连诺上校站在行刑队面前，必将想起父亲带他去见识冰块的那个遥远的下午。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-11
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-11
summary_en: Latest AI advancements in reasoning capabilities, system optimizations, model releases, and scaling infrastructure developments.
summary_zh: AI推理能力前沿进展、系统优化、模型发布及规模基础设施发展。
best_quote_en: Base models already contain reasoning mechanisms; 'thinking models' learn when to invoke them.
best_quote_zh: 基础模型已经包含推理机制；'思维模型'学习的是何时调用这些机制。

title: New AI-powered features help you connect with web content in Search and Discover.
title_zh: 全新AI功能助您在搜索和发现中连接网络内容
summary_en: Google introduces AI-powered features in Search and Discover to help users find trending content and sports updates.
summary_zh: 谷歌在搜索和发现中推出AI功能，帮助用户获取趋势内容和体育更新。
best_quote_en: Our testing shows this makes it easier to catch up on stories from a wide range of publishers and creators.
best_quote_zh: 我们的测试表明，这让用户更容易了解来自各种发布者和创作者的故事。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-10
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-10
summary_en: Comprehensive AI development update covering humanoid robots, open-source models, developer tools, benchmarks, and performance optimizations.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报全面报道人形机器人、开源模型、开发工具和性能优化进展。
best_quote_en: The video contains no remote control content, positioning F.03 for Helix, home, and global scale applications.
best_quote_zh: 影片中没有任何内容是远程操控的，将F.03定位为面向Helix、家庭和全球规模化应用。

title: Nano Banana is coming to Google Search, NotebookLM and Photos.
title_zh: Nano Banana 即将登陆 Google 搜索、NotebookLM 和相册
summary_en: Google is expanding its Nano Banana AI image editing tool from Gemini to Search, NotebookLM, and Photos for creative visual transformations.
summary_zh: 谷歌将Nano Banana AI图像编辑工具从Gemini扩展到搜索、NotebookLM和相册，用于创意视觉转换。
best_quote_en: Now, we’re bringing Nano Banana to Google Search and NotebookLM (and soon to Photos), helping more people access these advanced capabilities in products where they’re already exploring, learning and creating with visuals.
best_quote_zh: 现在，我们将Nano Banana引入Google搜索和NotebookLM（并很快引入相册），帮助更多人在他们已经在探索、学习和创造视觉内容的产品中访问这些先进功能。

title: Haberman reveals why Trump attacked judge and his family in speech
title_zh: 哈伯曼揭示特朗普为何在演讲中攻击法官及其家人
summary_en: Maggie Haberman explains Trump's motivations for attacking the judge and his family after his arraignment.
summary_zh: 哈伯曼解释特朗普在提审后攻击法官及其家人的动机。
best_quote_en: Haberman explains the reasoning behind Donald Trump's attacks on the judge and his family.
best_quote_zh: 哈伯曼解释特朗普攻击法官及其家人的背后原因。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-09
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-09
summary_en: Daily AI developer report covering micro reasoning models, JEPA density estimation, multi-modal systems, and agent infrastructure advancements.
summary_zh: AI开发者日报涵盖微型推理模型、JEPA密度估计和多模态系统与智能体基础设施进展。
best_quote_en: Less is more: fewer layers improve generalization (4→2 layers: Sudoku from 79.5% to 87.4%)
best_quote_zh: 少即是多：更少的层数改善了泛化能力（4层→2层：数独任务从79.5%提升至87.4%）

title: How to edit images with Nano Banana in Search
title_zh: 如何在搜索中使用 Nano Banana 编辑图片
summary_en: Google introduces Nano Banana in Search via Lens and AI Mode for instant image editing and creation.
summary_zh: 谷歌在搜索中推出Nano Banana，通过Lens和AI模式实现即时图片编辑和创作。
best_quote_en: Ready to unleash your imagination and have a whole bunch of fun with photos?
best_quote_zh: 准备好释放你的想象力，在照片中享受一整串的乐趣了吗？

title: Syrian refugee elected mayor of German town, years after fleeing war
title_zh: 叙利亚难民当选德国小镇镇长，数年前逃离战争
summary_en: A Syrian refugee who fled war in 2015 was elected mayor of a German town, demonstrating successful integration and political participation.
summary_zh: 一名2015年逃离战争的叙利亚难民当选德国小镇镇长，展现了成功的融合与政治参与。
best_quote_en: "Today, Ostelsheim sent an example for broad-mindedness and cosmopolitanism for the whole of Germany."
best_quote_zh: "今天，奥斯特尔斯海姆为整个德国树立了开放思想和世界主义的榜样。"

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-07
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-07
summary_en: OpenAI DevDay announces major platform updates including Apps SDK, AgentKit, GPT-5 Pro, Sora 2 APIs, and new model releases with significant price reductions.
summary_zh: OpenAI开发者大会发布应用SDK、AgentKit、GPT-5 Pro和Sora 2 API，并推出多款新模型及大幅降价。
best_quote_en: OpenAI is turning ChatGPT into an app platform with Apps SDK enabling interactive applications directly within ChatGPT.
best_quote_zh: OpenAI正将ChatGPT转变为应用平台，Apps SDK让合作伙伴能将完整交互应用直接嵌入ChatGPT。

title: Video Overviews on NotebookLM get a major upgrade with Nano Banana
title_zh: NotebookLM 的视频概述功能通过 Nano Banana 实现重大升级
summary_en: NotebookLM upgrades Video Overviews with Nano Banana's image generation and adds a Brief format for quick insights.
summary_zh: NotebookLM 视频概述通过 Nano Banana 图像生成升级，新增快速摘要格式。
best_quote_en: Nano Banana in NotebookLM generates helpful, contextual, and beautiful illustrations based on the sources you upload.
best_quote_zh: Nano Banana 在 NotebookLM 中根据您上传的源文件生成有用、上下文相关且美观的插图。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-15
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-15
summary_en: Daily AI developer update covering hardware comparisons, new frameworks, model benchmarks, and infrastructure innovations in machine learning.
summary_zh: 涵盖硬件对比、新框架发布、模型基准测试和机器学习基础设施创新的AI开发者日报。
best_quote_en: The world needs more compute power - OpenAI leadership on 10 GW custom accelerator partnership with Broadcom.
best_quote_zh: 世界需要更多算力——OpenAI领导层就与博通的10吉瓦定制加速器合作发表评论。

title: Introducing Veo 3.1 and advanced capabilities in Flow
title_zh: 介绍 Veo 3.1 和 Flow 中的高级功能
summary_en: Google DeepMind introduces Veo 3.1 with enhanced audio, narrative control, and editing tools for AI video creation in Flow.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Veo 3.1，增强音频、叙事控制和编辑工具，提升 AI 视频创作体验。
best_quote_en: With more precise editing capabilities, audio across all existing features and higher-quality outputs powered by Veo 3.1, we're opening up new possibilities for richer, more powerful video storytelling.
best_quote_zh: 凭借更精确的编辑功能、所有现有功能的音频支持以及由 Veo 3.1 驱动的高质量输出，我们正在为更丰富、更强大的视频叙事开辟新的可能性。

title: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-06
title_zh: AI 开发者日报 2025-10-06
summary_en: Comprehensive AI development update covering coding agents, video generation, robotics, and reinforcement learning with latest model rankings and breakthroughs.
summary_zh: 全面AI开发更新，涵盖编程智能体、视频生成、机器人和强化学习，包含最新模型排名与突破。
best_quote_en: "Terence Tao publicly documented using GPT-5 with tool functions to find counterexamples and heuristics in mathematics."
best_quote_zh: "陶哲轩公开记录使用 GPT-5 结合工具功能在数学中寻找反例和启发式方法。

title: How a Gemma model helped discover a new potential cancer therapy pathway
title_zh: Gemma模型如何帮助发现新的潜在癌症治疗途径
summary_en: A 27-billion parameter AI model identified a novel cancer therapy pathway by discovering synergistic drug effects, validated through lab experiments.
summary_zh: 一个270亿参数的AI模型通过发现协同药物效应识别出新的癌症治疗途径，并通过实验验证。
best_quote_en: The model predicted a strong increase in antigen presentation when silmitasertib was applied in the 'immune-context-positive' setting, but little to no effect in the 'immune-context-neutral' one.
best_quote_zh: 模型预测在'免疫环境阳性'设置中应用silmitasertib会显著增加抗原呈递，但在'免疫环境中性'设置中几乎没有效果。

title: Kwame Brathwaite, photographer of 'Black is Beautiful' movement, dies at 85
title_zh: Kwame Brathwaite，'黑即是美'运动摄影师，逝世，享年85岁
summary_en: Pioneering photographer Kwame Brathwaite, who defined the 'Black is Beautiful' movement through his work celebrating Black culture and beauty, has died at 85.
summary_zh: 开拓性摄影师Kwame Brathwaite通过作品定义'黑即是美'运动，颂扬黑人文化与美，逝世享年85岁。
best_quote_en: "You want to get the feeling, the mood that you're experiencing when they're playing. That's the thing. You want to capture that."
best_quote_zh: "你想要捕捉他们演奏时的感觉和氛围。这才是关键。你想要捕捉那种感觉。"

title: Britain's pound is beating every other major currency this year
title_zh: 英国英镑今年表现优于所有其他主要货币
summary_en: The British pound has become the best-performing major currency in 2023, rebounding strongly from last year's lows due to economic resilience and interest rate expectations.
summary_zh: 英国英镑今年表现最佳，因经济韧性和加息预期从去年低点强劲反弹。
best_quote_en: Sterling hit its highest level against the US dollar in 10 months on Tuesday, topping $1.25 for the first time since June 2022.
best_quote_zh: 英镑周二兑美元汇率创下10个月新高，自2022年6月以来首次突破1.25美元。

title: 10 ways you can ask Google Photos to edit your photos for you
title_zh: 10种方法让Google Photos帮你编辑照片
summary_en: Google Photos now allows users to edit images through conversational prompts, offering 10 creative examples for AI-powered photo enhancements.
summary_zh: Google Photos现可通过对话指令编辑照片，提供10种AI增强创意示例。
best_quote_en: It's easier than ever to edit your images in Google Photos — all you have to do is ask.
best_quote_zh: 在Google Photos中编辑图像比以往任何时候都更容易——你只需要开口要求。

title: The four astronauts NASA picked for the first crewed moon mission in 50 years
title_zh: NASA挑选四名宇航员执行50年来首次载人登月任务
summary_en: NASA reveals the four astronauts selected for Artemis II, the first crewed moon mission since 1972.
summary_zh: NASA公布四名宇航员，将执行50年来首次载人绕月飞行任务。
best_quote_en: "It's so much more than the four names that have been announced... It is the next step in the journey that will get humanity to Mars."
best_quote_zh: “这远不止是公布的四个名字……这是将人类送上火星之旅的下一步。”

title: AI Mode is now available in more languages and locations around the world.
title_zh: AI 模式现已在全球更多语言和地区推出
summary_en: Google Search expands AI Mode to 35+ languages and 40+ countries, powered by Gemini models for natural language understanding.
summary_zh: 谷歌搜索 AI 模式新增 35 种语言和 40 个国家，由 Gemini 模型驱动实现自然语言理解。
best_quote_en: The advanced reasoning and multimodal understanding of our custom Gemini model allows AI Mode to truly grasp the subtleties of local languages.
best_quote_zh: 我们定制 Gemini 模型的高级推理和多模态理解使 AI 模式能真正掌握本地语言的细微差别。

title: These are the animals people most want to see photographed
title_zh: 人们最希望拍摄到的动物
summary_en: The New Big 5 photography book showcases endangered wildlife through stunning images to raise conservation awareness.
summary_zh: 《新五大动物》摄影书通过精美图片展示濒危野生动物，旨在提高环保意识。
best_quote_en: "We have a window of time during which we can start to heal some of the harm we have inflicted on the natural world, but only if we get together and take action now."
best_quote_zh: "我们有一个时间窗口可以开始修复我们对自然世界造成的伤害，但前提是我们必须立即团结起来采取行动。"

title: 10 years of genomics research at Google
title_zh: 谷歌基因组研究的十年历程
summary_en: Google's decade-long genomics research used AI to improve DNA sequencing accuracy and develop tools for healthcare and biodiversity applications.
summary_zh: 谷歌十年基因组研究利用AI提升DNA测序精度并开发医疗和生物多样性工具。
best_quote_en: The advancement of genomics over the past decade comes down to our approach to creating an innovation flywheel: we are driven by a real-world problem to conduct fundamental computer science research.
best_quote_zh: 过去十年基因组学的进步归功于我们创建创新飞轮的方法：我们被现实世界问题驱动进行基础计算机科学研究。

title: DeepSomatic, an open-source AI model, is speeding up genetic analysis for cancer research.
title_zh: DeepSomatic，一个开源AI模型，正在加速癌症研究的基因分析
summary_en: DeepSomatic uses AI to accurately identify cancer-driving genetic variants, outperforming current methods and accelerating global research.
summary_zh: DeepSomatic利用AI精确识别癌症驱动基因变异，超越现有方法，加速全球癌症研究。
best_quote_en: The tool is proven to outperform current methods at spotting these key variants, particularly insertions and deletions.
best_quote_zh: 该工具被证明在检测这些关键变异（特别是插入和删除）方面优于现有方法。

title: 2023 March Madness: Will UConn or San Diego State triumph in the national championship game that 'means everything?'
title_zh: 2023年疯狂三月：康涅狄格大学还是圣地亚哥州立大学将在全国冠军赛中胜出？
summary_en: UConn defeated San Diego State 76-59 to win its fifth men's basketball national championship title.
summary_zh: 康涅狄格大学以76-59战胜圣地亚哥州立大学，赢得第五个男子篮球全国冠军。
best_quote_en: "We knew we were the best team in the tournament going in and we just had to play to our level," said UConn coach Dan Hurley.
best_quote_zh: 康涅狄格大学教练丹·赫尔利表示：“我们知道自己是锦标赛中最强的球队，只需打出我们的水平。”

title: Investing in America 2025
title_zh: 投资美国 2025
summary_en: Google announces major US investments in AI infrastructure, workforce development, and energy capacity to advance American innovation and economic growth.
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布在美国大规模投资AI基础设施、劳动力发展和能源容量，以推动美国创新和经济增长。
best_quote_en: Through major investments in technical infrastructure, research and development — along with expanded energy capacity for an AI-driven economy and workforce development and education programs — we will help the U.S. continue to lead the world in AI.
best_quote_zh: 通过对技术基础设施、研发的重大投资，以及为AI驱动经济扩展能源容量和劳动力发展与教育计划，我们将帮助美国继续在AI领域引领世界。

title: Beijing promised to 'fight back' over Taiwan leader's US visit. But this time it has more to lose
title_zh: 北京承诺对台湾领导人访美'坚决回击'，但这次损失可能更大
summary_en: China faces strategic constraints in responding to Tsai-McCarthy meeting amid global tensions and Taiwan's upcoming election.
summary_zh: 中国在全球局势紧张和台湾选举前对蔡麦会面回应面临战略制约。
best_quote_en: "This puts the burden on China not to overreact, because any overreaction is only going to push China further away from the world," said Yun Sun, director of the China Program at the Stimson Center think tank in Washington.
best_quote_zh: 华盛顿智库史汀生中心中国项目主任孙韵表示：“这给中国带来了不要反应过度的负担，因为任何过度反应只会让中国离世界更远。”

title: Introducing the Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model
title_zh: Gemini 2.5 计算机使用模型发布
summary_en: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model enabling AI agents to interact with user interfaces via API.
summary_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 2.5 计算机使用模型，通过 API 实现 AI 代理与用户界面交互。
best_quote_en: The ability to natively fill out forms, manipulate interactive elements and operate behind logins is a crucial next step in building powerful, general-purpose agents.
best_quote_zh: 原生填写表单、操作交互元素并在登录后工作的能力是构建强大通用代理的关键下一步。

title: Micron Technology: China probes US chip maker for cybersecurity risks as tech tension escalates
title_zh: 美光科技：中国调查美国芯片制造商网络安全风险，科技紧张局势升级
summary_en: China launches cybersecurity probe into Micron Technology amid escalating tech tensions with US and allies over semiconductor restrictions.
summary_zh: 中国对美光科技启动网络安全审查，美中科技紧张局势因半导体限制升级。
best_quote_en: The move is aimed at ensuring the security of key information infrastructure supply chains, preventing cybersecurity risks, and maintaining national security.
best_quote_zh: 此举旨在保障关键信息基础设施供应链安全，防范网络安全风险，维护国家安全。

title: Google AI Plus is coming to 36 more countries.
title_zh: Google AI Plus 即将登陆 36 个新国家
summary_en: Google AI Plus expands to 36 more countries, offering enhanced AI features and a limited-time 50% discount for new subscribers.
summary_zh: Google AI Plus 扩展至 36 个国家，提供增强 AI 功能和限时 50% 新用户折扣。
best_quote_en: Google AI Plus is our new plan designed to help people do more with the latest Google AI models and features, for less.
best_quote_zh: Google AI Plus 是我们的新计划，旨在帮助人们以更低成本利用最新的 Google AI 模型和功能做更多事情。

title: What OPEC's surprise oil cut means for gas prices
title_zh: OPEC意外减产对汽油价格意味着什么
summary_en: OPEC+'s surprise oil production cut will raise US gas prices and reignite inflation concerns.
summary_zh: OPEC+意外减产将推高美国汽油价格并重燃通胀担忧。
best_quote_en: "I think OPEC is reawakening the inflation monster. The White House has to be shocked and major-time pissed."
best_quote_zh: "我认为OPEC正在重新唤醒通胀怪兽。白宫肯定感到震惊且极度愤怒。"

title: Googler Michel Devoret awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics
title_zh: 谷歌员工 Michel Devoret 获诺贝尔物理学奖
summary_en: Google Quantum AI scientist Michel Devoret wins 2025 Nobel Prize for foundational work enabling modern superconducting quantum computing.
summary_zh: 谷歌量子AI科学家因奠定超导量子计算基础的突破性研究获2025年诺贝尔物理学奖。
best_quote_en: They proved that quantum mechanics could be revealed and controlled in a macroscopic electrical circuit on a chip.
best_quote_zh: 他们证明了量子力学可以在芯片上的宏观电路中显现并受控。
